description: This file defines a route loader module for Next.js, handling route prefetching, script and stylesheet loading, and build manifest integration.

classes.name: RouteLoader
classes.description: Interface for route loading operations including entrypoint resolution, route loading, and prefetching.

methods.name: withFuture
methods.description: Handles promise resolution and caching for route entrypoints.

methods.name: hasPrefetch
methods.description: Detects if the browser supports prefetch via link rel or IE11 detection.

methods.name: prefetchViaDom
methods.description: Creates a link element to prefetch assets dynamically.

methods.name: markAssetError
methods.description: Marks an error as an asset load error.

methods.name: isAssetError
methods.description: Checks if an error is marked as an asset load error.

methods.name: appendScript
methods.description: Dynamically appends a script element to the document body.

methods.name: resolvePromiseWithTimeout
methods.description: Wraps a promise with a timeout, rejecting if the timeout is exceeded.

methods.name: getClientBuildManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the client build manifest, with caching and timeout handling.

methods.name: getFilesForRoute
methods.description: Fetches script and CSS files for a given route, using build manifest in production or static paths in development.

methods.name: createRouteLoader
methods.description: Factory function that creates a route loader object with methods for route management.
